COCONUT SAFETY NETS

Heavy-gauge canopy nets suspended beneath coconut palms to safely catch falling coconuts and fronds.

Direct Quotation: Custom Site Quote
Durability Warranty: 3 to 5 Years UV Stable

A falling coconut weighing 2 to 4 kg descending from a 30-foot tree generates sufficient kinetic energy to shatter vehicle windshields, dent roof hoods, or cause fatal cranial trauma to pedestrians. Invisible Safety Coconut Safety Nets are engineered with heavy-ply knotted nylon and HDPE braids slung under the canopy crown, deflecting and cradling falling nuts before they reach ground level.

Impact Absorption Withstands 50+ kg dynamic drop force without rupture
